notes: KNOWN FAILING (partially) — muse genuinely detaches a slow bash command (tool_batch.effect.terminal.outcome.task_completion.kind=="pending"; 1/374 real local corpus examples, the other 373 resolved synchronously within <=7.66s), with the runtime's own injected tool guidance confirming this is intentional ("...wakes you even after you end the turn... Do not poll..."). But the muse parser (core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/parser.go) observes NONE of task_stream_linked / tool_batch.effect.* / the task's own kind:"task" lifecycle events — so BackgroundProcessCount can never be non-zero for muse today; that half of the scenario's acceptance criteria is unverifiable by this spec format regardless of outcome. RECIPE: the prompt runs `sleep 20 && echo BG_DONE` and replies the literal token BGPROC_OK IMMEDIATELY once the tool call returns control, without polling — mirroring the sibling agents' recipes to deliberately test whether the session settles to ready before the 20s sleep finishes. OPEN QUESTION (see metadata.json body): a corpus-wide scan found muse's own run.terminal (-> EventType="turn_done", the daemon's existing working->ready trigger) never fired before an enclosing run's background bash tasks resolved in 372/372 real examples — but no corpus example ever had the model try to end its turn early while a background task was genuinely still pending, so it is UNCONFIRMED whether that holds when the model deliberately stops immediately (this recipe). bg_alive_working's duration (12000ms) is sized to sit inside that gap: longer than the ~10-15s a premature turn-close would take, shorter than the ~20-25s full background lifetime. CORRECT arc per the scenario spec: ready->working, held working through the full ~20-25s background lifetime, then a single working->ready. Single-birth session model (muse's session id = directory basename, fixed at session start): session_birth anchors to "start" unpinned; every later phase is pinned same_session_as:session_birth because muse spawns companion reminder/goal-check subagents freely (also tagged execution_mode:"background") that could otherwise satisfy an unpinned phase vacuously (2-2 and 2-17 both hit this). No cost is ever persisted for muse-spark-1.3-contributor (no pricing/alias entry, re-confirmed on this machine's most recent 2026-09-14 sessions), so cost_nonzero is false; tokens are used on every model call, so tokens_nonzero is true.
